What verification establishes

The site retrieves the private grading definition saved in this instructor browser and recomputes the checksum from the assignment, question positions, protected source data and instruction images. It must match your recorded checksum before Python grades the designated answer cells.

A match verifies the issued content, not who completed it or whether AI was used. Keep your own checksum record; a value copied from a student’s file is not an independent record. Answers and ordinary Excel save changes are excluded.

New student workbooks contain no embedded grading map. Private grading records are saved on this device; clearing site storage removes them. To grade elsewhere, restore the private instructor archive on the generator page. Files and grades are processed in this browser.
